mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% in the prior 1-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% in a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous deterioration in the labor market (UNRATE > 4.0%) and industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals an imminent recession, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days due to compounded economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% and INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and sustained for 3 months), increased cost of capital and reduced liquidity lead to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 thousand units in a 1-month window signals weak consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1400.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 in a 1-month window signals an economic contraction, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS < 680000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1450.0) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 680000 and HOUST < 1450.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% in a 1-month window signals inflationary pressures, prompting central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.
